summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of FUTURA NODES landing page. All core features working correctly including hero section, sector segmentation, dynamic form fields, form validation, submission flow, and WhatsApp integration.
passed_tests: Hero section loads with correct headline 'Te dijeron que con tener una web mejorarían tus ventas?'
CTA button 'Quiero mis clientes' scrolls smoothly to form section
All 4 segmentation cards (Servicios, E-commerce, Local, Otro) are clickable
Selected sector shows green border and checkmark indicator
Dynamic form fields appear correctly for Servicios sector (tipo servicio, clientes nuevos, presupuesto)
Dynamic form fields appear correctly for E-commerce sector (tipo producto, ventas/mes, ticket promedio, presupuesto)
Dynamic form fields appear correctly for Local sector (tipo negocio, ubicacion, clientes/mes, presupuesto)
Dynamic form fields appear correctly for Otro sector (descripcion, clientes/ventas, presupuesto)
Form validation works with HTML5 native validation (email format, min length for nombre and telefono)
Warning message shown when no sector is selected
Submit button disabled when no sector is selected
Form submission works with mock webhook (1.5s delay)
Loading state shown during form submission
Confirmation page displays with personalized name
WhatsApp button has correct link (wa.me/56973027813) with personalized message
Toast notification 'Formulario enviado correctamente' shown on success
